summary: The experiments support the incoming Colorado local-context account, but sharpen it: this neuron is especially sensitive to Colorado Front Range place and contact context, including 303, 720, 970 and 719 telephone numbers. In a fixed template, Colorado city names raised the response at a shared 303 contact line to 86.5-126.0, versus 8.8-22.5 for matched Billings, Boise, Cheyenne and Salt Lake City contexts; genuine Colorado venues gave 90.5-144.0 at ' call', while a Colorado-themed venue in Montana gave 9.8. Colorado area-code candidates also produced much larger replacement-span maxima (141-191) than non-Colorado codes (2.25-11.1). The negative pole remains heterogeneous: Qinghai provincial snippets produced minima of -25.9 to -36.8 and the blind writer found a -52.75 Qinghai example, while Montana BLM and North Dakota civic records and Highcharts/source markup were also negative; other Chinese provinces and ordinary prose were weak and inconsistent. The blind positive writer reached 312.0 against the 322.0 corpus maximum, and the blind negative writer reached -52.75 against -73.5. The main unresolved alternative is that some of the response is a token-level numeric/area-code effect embedded in Colorado local text rather than a fully compositional Colorado concept.

p1.name: Longmont golf-course contact listing
p1.description: A Longmont event and membership listing that ends at the space before a 303 telephone number (product 304). Upstream flow is dominated by L38_N489 and L14_N489, with smaller positive contributions from L49_N12697 and L6_N25239; this is the clearest positive contact-line member.

p2.name: Boulder County farm report
p2.description: A Boulder County agriculture and Front Range flood report whose selected 'in' reaches product 290. It shares the positive L38_N489/L14_N489 contribution but has a stronger L6_N7831 and L6_N25239 component, showing that the positive route also covers Colorado prose without a telephone number.

p3.name: Colorado running-club sports profile
p3.description: A Colorado Rage running-club and high-school sports profile whose selected 'At' reaches product 294. L14_N489 and L38_N489 are the largest contributors, with L49_N12697 and L13_N11715 also positive; this route covers sports/community biography rather than event contact records.

n1.name: Mixed Qinghai, civic, code and prose negatives
n1.description: This negative numerical route contains five unlike members: Qinghai '日报' (-54.5), a Montana BLM 406-number digit (-45.75), Highcharts '.data' (-43.5), a Slamdance prose 'more' (-15.625), and a credit-repair period (-4.3125). L14_N8626 and L38_N8626 are negative contributors, while L6_N24380 and L6_N6972 change sign across members. The route is not a semantic class.

n2.name: Weak math-homework period
n2.description: A single weak negative member: the final period of a math-homework post (-0.578). L6_N24380 and L6_N6972 contribute negatively, but the magnitude is small and the member is too isolated to support a semantic name.

n3.name: JavaScript polyfill syntax
n3.description: One JavaScript URLSearchParams polyfill member at a semicolon (-1.211). L6_N24380 and L6_N6972 are negative contributors and L52_N19157 also appears; the source-markup cue is clear but the response is much weaker than the Highcharts example.

clusters.name: Colorado Front Range local and sports text
clusters.story: Membership criterion: positive selected products in Colorado Front Range text. The three members cover a Longmont golf-course contact line, a Boulder County farm and flood report, and a Colorado running-club profile; their anchors are space, 'in' and 'At'. They share strong L38_N489/L14_N489 upstream flow but differ in genre and route weight, so this is a local-context cluster rather than one fixed template.

clusters.name: Qinghai newspaper trailer
clusters.story: Membership criterion: Chinese-language text whose observed prefix ends at 青海日报 after a long mixed news page. The single member is the clearest Qinghai example here; its '日报' anchor is negative and L14_N8626/L38_N8626 are negative while L6_N24380/L6_N6972 are positive. One member supports a provincial-news association, not a broad Chinese-language rule.

clusters.name: Non-Colorado civic contact record
clusters.story: Membership criterion: a U.S. civic or contact record outside Colorado. The member is a Montana BLM lease notice ending at a 406 telephone number; the selected local-exchange digit is strongly negative. It shares negative numeric contributions with other English records but not the Chinese context, so it remains a separate non-Colorado civic-contact condition.

clusters.name: Source code and technical markup
clusters.story: Membership criterion: technical source-code or markup anchors. Highcharts '.data' is strongly negative, whereas the JavaScript URLSearchParams semicolon is only weakly negative; both occur in dense code and have negative L6_N24380/L6_N6972 contributions. The large magnitude difference is an explicit exception to treating every code token as one response class.

clusters.name: Weak heterogeneous prose negatives
clusters.story: Membership criterion: remaining weak negative prose without a code, Qinghai, or civic-contact account. Slamdance film prose, a credit-repair disclaimer period, and a math-homework final period are semantically unrelated; products are weak and upstream patterns do not identify a shared cue. This is an unresolved mixed cluster, retained rather than forced into a semantic story.

spectrum.summary: Across 495 blind-labelled points, the six incoming groups split into 55 Colorado-local, 11 Colorado-sports, 9 Qinghai-news, 105 source-code, 15 non-Colorado-civic and 300 no-visible-cue cases. Colorado-local products reach 322 and 54/55 are positive; sports reach 270. Qinghai is uniformly negative (-10.5 to -38.75), while source-code and no-cue samples cross zero.

search.summary: At the declared ' call' marker, six Colorado local-contact candidates had median 7.31 (best 18.13) versus -0.20 for matched out-of-state controls. In the fixed-template city sweep, Colorado names at a shared 303 line measured 86.5-126.0, while Billings, Boise, Cheyenne and Salt Lake City measured 8.8-22.5. At '发布', Qinghai candidates had median -4.37 versus 0.005 for other provincial news.

clusters.summary: Ten natural members form five display clusters: three positive Colorado Front Range texts, one Qinghai media trailer, one Montana civic contact record, two code or markup cases, and three weak heterogeneous prose negatives. The n1 numerical route crosses Qinghai, civic, code and prose categories, so raw routes are not semantic classes.

anatomy.summary: The 454-point anatomy view shows product as gate times value: the largest positive anchors combine strongly positive gate and value, while negative products arise mainly from positive gate and negative value. The selected Longmont trace peaks on the space before 303 (18.5 times 17.375 equals 322).
anatomy.strip_caption: Selected saved Longmont event-listing trace: gate and value rise together through the final contact line, peaking on the space before the 303 number at product 322; the following area-code digits remain strongly positive.

ablation.summary: The weight-only logit lens for +1 product raises Boulder (+0.743), Colorado (+0.729), Denver (+0.722), Colo (+0.652) and Broncos (+0.528). Across 109 measured conditions, target zeroing gave median KL 0.00174 versus 0.00041 for same-layer random controls; the Longmont phone-boundary graph was far more sensitive (KL 4.56).

family.summary: Across eleven authored inputs, the target neuron was highest on Colorado city plus 303/720/970 contact lines, lower on matched out-of-state lines, and weakest with no phone or generic context. Upstream units tracked Longmont or place-name tokens and phone digits; downstream units showed mixed positive and negative boundary responses.

circuit.summary: Across fifteen atlas graphs, the dominant upstream contributors were L38_N489 and L14_N489, with L49_N12697, L6_N25239, L6_N7831 and L31_N11703 also frequent. The thirty downstream readers split by sign, led by L62_N21256, L59_N9433 and L57_N16330.

tests.summary: The blind writer's positive candidates reached 312.0, near the 322.0 corpus maximum, and all six were Colorado-local contact texts. Negative candidates reached -52.75 versus the -73.5 minimum, led by Qinghai news, Highcharts markup, Montana BLM and North Dakota records; route prediction was disabled.
